title: The Dolly Lounge
description:
Beautiful condo with a great location in Nashville. 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a lounge space with a Dolly Parton theme! Conveniently located less than 10 minutes to Broadway and East Nashville, less than 15 minutes to the Grand Ole Opry!

The space
With 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and space to sleep 7, this is a great space for a small group.  The property has three floors. 

The first floor has an open concept living and dining room, including a dining table and bar stools to sit 7+ for a meal that you can prepare in the fully stocked kitchen! Kitchen includes a Keurig coffee machine with plenty of pods, creamer, and sweeteners provided. The first floor also contains a half bath. 

The second floor features a music-themed master bedroom with two queen beds with comfy memory foam mattresses. Guitars and records on the wall, drums for end tables filled with multi-colored fairy lights, and a mural that puts you front and center for a live show! The second floor features a spacious master bathroom with a beautiful walk-in shower and dual sinks. There’s also a full-sized washer and dryer on the second floor that guests are welcome to use with laundry detergent and fabric softener provided. 

The third floor features a loft area decorated in tribute to Dolly Parton! The third floor bedroom is decorated with an outdoors theme, featuring birch trees and a boxwood wall.  This bedroom includes a queen size bed with a comfy memory foam mattress and a couch that folds out into a bed that can comfortably sleep one adult. There is a full bath on the third floor and a great balcony space for enjoying some fresh air.

Guest access
We offer a key-less entry to provide a hassle free check in. You are able to access the entire house to yourselves, excluding one supply closet.
